enrichment.headline: Awards G & G Builders $116,977 for new playground and court work at OAK at Howard
schools: Oakland Academy of Knowledge at Howard Elementary School
enrichment.summary: G & G Builders, Inc. of Livermore, the lowest responsive bidder, will tear out old basketball hoops, prepare the site for a multi-sport court, and install new playground tiles at Oakland Academy of Knowledge at Howard Elementary School. The price is $116,977, including a $10,000 contingency allowance. Work is expected to run about 60 days starting September 29, 2022.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
items.title: Agreement Between Owner and Contractor – G & G Builders, Inc. – OAK at Howard Elementary School Site Improvements Project - Division of Facilities Planning and Management

enrichment.headline: Pays ACC Environmental Consultants up to $7,760.50 to test soil at Howard Elementary site
schools: Oakland Academy of Knowledge at Howard Elementary School
enrichment.summary: ACC Environmental Consultants of Oakland will sample and test soil for lead and arsenic, characterize soil waste, and write reports for the Oakland Academy of Knowledge at Howard Elementary School site improvements project. The cost is capped at $7,760.50, including up to $705.50 for additional services. Work runs September 29 to December 29, 2022.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
items.title: General Services Agreement – ACC Environmental Consultants – Oakland Academy of Knowledge at Howard Elementary School Site Improvements Project - Division of Facilities Planning and Management

enrichment.headline: Adds $32,486.36 to G & G Builders' East Oakland Pride playground project
enrichment.summary: This change order adds asphalt patching and replacement of a concrete slab in the old kindergarten area to the East Oakland Pride Elementary School playmatting and structure project. It adds $32,486.36 and raises the contract's not-to-exceed amount from $596,516 to $629,002.36 with G & G Builders, Inc. of Livermore.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
